edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender for transfer().
msg.sender supplies the spender for transferFrom allowance handling.
msg.sender flows through _transfer into the _tokenTransfer permission checks.
constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
unlock compares msg.sender with _previousOwner to authorise restoration.
block.timestamp is compared to _lockTime, making unlock timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
approve delegates to the internal _approve writer.
airdrop invokes _transfer, which reaches _tokenTransfer.
airdropArray drives the batch transfer loop.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth on half of the balance.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the other half.
swapAndLiquify pays ETH to marketingWallet before completing liquidity addition.
Router swap is an external call that could re-enter the contract.
addLiquidityETH forwards ETH to an external contract.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded.
_transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify external interaction before balances are settled.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount cap.
_transfer compares the contract balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer checks uniswapV2Pair to avoid circular liquidity events.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
claimTokens forwards the entire contract balance to marketingWallet.
claimOtherTokens performs an external ERC20 transfer to a supplied wallet.
clearStuckBalance forwards the contract balance to a caller-supplied address.
lock computes _lockTime as block.timestamp + time.
lock reassigns _owner to address(0), changing access control state.
unlock gates execution on the timestamp-based _lockTime check.
unlock requires the caller to match _previousOwner.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner address.
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner address.
onlyOwner guard restricts claimTokens to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts claimOtherTokens to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts clearStuckBalance to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts setTaxFeePercent to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts setMaxTxAmount to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts lock to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts transferOwnership to _owner.
onlyOwner guard restricts renounceOwnership to _owner.
canTrade restricts trading to the owner when disabled.
botWallets blacklist blocks listed senders and recipients.
lockTheSwap sets inSwapAndLiquify to block recursive swap-and-liquify.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic liquidity swap.
uniswapV2Router is used to build the swap path and execute the swap.
uniswapV2Router receives the addLiquidityETH call.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeLiquidity credits reflection tokens to the contract balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the fee, affecting supply math.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply values.
constructor stores the created Uniswap pair in uniswapV2Pair.
constructor stores the router in uniswapV2Router.
constructor initialises the owner through the Ownable constructor.
constructor excludes owner and contract from fees in _isExcludedFromFee.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a call parameter of transfer and carries no independent state semantics.
amount is only a call parameter of transfer and is fully handled by _transfer validation.
newOwner is a transient parameter written directly into _owner by transferOwnership.
time is a transient parameter used only to compute _lockTime in lock.
contractTokenBalance is a transient parameter split inside swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is a transient parameter consumed by the router swap call.
ethAmount is a transient parameter forwarded as value to addLiquidityETH.
